name: medqa_s3_v1_r2_strict_late
responses: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.
I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.
I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
